xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex75012023-09-28-091757" status="unreviewed"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5197"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3711"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan</rs> gyi 'grel pa</rs> don gsal gyi rnam par bshad pa mi pham dgongs pa'i rgyan</rs> zhes bya ba 'di | bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa la rnam dpyod kyi skal ba gzhan las mi dman par gyur pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5198">shAkya'i dge slong blo gros rgya mtsho</rs> zhes bya bas mkhas grub du ma'i 'byung gnas <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6173">dpal ldan gsang phu ne'u thog gi gtsug lag khang</rs> du sbyar ba rdzogs so ||</seg></TEI>
